gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Loose, one-nib swagger: that's Gabarito, terminals cut open and counters flowing outward. Noto Sans Cypriot, a friendly sans whose e opens up, can drop to a modest size and still read comfortably.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoa: A one-nib drawn look, terminals cut open, defines Gabarito. Gabarito does its best with attention-grabbing character up top, while Noto Sans Cypro Minoan does its best staying contemporary and businesslike, its cut-back terminals leaving big gaps.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohi: Expressive from the first stroke, Gabarito has a one-nib look, and Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya adds a visibly gaping c. The heading announces itself, then the body gets on with the talking.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Gabarito draws each stroke without any contrast in its line. Noto Sans Hatran has a funnel-wide e and an approachable, neutral manner, so paragraphs go down smoothly, line after line.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi reads crisp and contemporary, its small counters never clogged. Beneath Gabarito, whose diagonals carry full weight, extended text keeps moving smoothly and never feels crowded.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Clean describes Noto Sans Javanese, whose apertures keep counters connected to outside space. But Gabarito is best at neon-tube consistency in every stroke, where Noto Sans Javanese is best at staying clear in text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Gabarito draws each letter with joins that hold their weight where strokes meet. And Noto Sans Kawi, with an open-jawed c, keeps text clean, so sturdiness is the quality that stands out.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Noto Sans Linear A reads clean and unfussy, its gaping c staying visibly open at any size. Gabarito holds a constant stroke weight with no sparkle, and that steadiness wins.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Gabarito bends tubular strokes like copper pipe, each terminal cut open so the counters flow outward. Noto Sans Linear B, a modern sans, lets text glide around each bend.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Modern and clean, Noto Sans Manichaean is a plain sans with open-mouthed e crossbars, topped by Gabarito and its thread-drawn curves. Text flows on smoothly without a single snag.
